item_1_rest_dominance.root_cause: EventDrivenBrain recovery latch (brain.py _step_recovery, brain.py:435-449) releases ONLY on hp_ratio >= recovery_hp_ratio (0.75). The latch is engaged by the decision-model react_damage 'rest' answer at ANY hp (brain.py:470-474; DEFAULT_STUB_ANSWERS react_damage=rest) and by the script hp<0.25 rest. In w35 the 10th damage receipt (t~833s) engaged the latch and the self-death receipt (deaths [2000001], ZC 0x0080 flag 1, own aid) presented HP=1 (clif.cpp:3683-3690 death presentation; native_vitals.py maps 0x00B0 param 5 = SP_HP) so the ratio never reached 0.75 again; Rest() dispatched every script step (2,387) while perform_native refused the dead sends, freezing wire counters. The named 'in-range monster stops rest' interrupt does NOT exist anywhere: tests/test_native_rest_interrupt.py pins the opposite (rest holds with an in-range monster; comments 'these tests pin rest/recovery, not approach'). The receipts' 'xp 76' label is the HP regen stream (param 5, 64->76), not experience — the kill-commit gate's xp_delta_positive is satisfied by resting, an operator receipt defect.

item_2_fx0_join_stall.root_cause: Named packet/step: ZC_ACCEPT_ENTER 0x02EB never arrives on fixture_0's map session, so BotClient._map_server (spikes/003-clientless-limbs/client.py:470) never sends LoadEndAck 0x007D; its 15s budget raises RuntimeError('no ZC_ACCEPT_ENTER from map-server') and the half-joined session is all the receipts show. Server truth (pinned rAthena e985006171d2): clif_parse_WantToConnection (clif.cpp:10647) answers a valid CZ_ENTER with 0x0283 SC_NOTIFY_AUTH then, after the char-server auth round-trip, clif_authok (clif.cpp:754-767) sends 0x02EB; double login answers 0x0081 err 8; malformed CZ_ENTER answers 0x006A. fx0's w34/w35 census received the post-auth map stream (0x91 prt_in [168,128], 0x9FF x6 spawns, 0x00B0 x20 status hp 86/86, 0x0ACB x4, 0x0360<->0x007F 1:1 keepalive) but NONE of 0x0283/0x02EB/0x0081/0x006A — an auth-handshake silence shape, not an rx desync (actor_parse_errors 0, every frame parsed). The stream shape matches an already-loaded server-side session for the fx0 account/char (previous session epoch not turned over), consistent with fx1 (field save) joining fine every window over the SAME production stack.
